kept.name: Visa
kept.why: Visa’s global refresh introduces a standalone V and Visa Sans, two elements to watch for on its homepage.

kept.name: HOFF
kept.why: HOFF’s colourful holiday installation turns its Madrid footwear flagship into a backdrop for art and coffee as well as shoes.

kept.name: Programa
kept.why: Programa’s redesign explains studio management through the details interior designers track, from product dimensions to material quantities.

kept.name: Volvo Cars
kept.why: Volvo Cars traces the EX60’s colours, materials and lighting to Scandinavian forests and seas.

kept.name: Mondaine
kept.why: A circular opening in Mondaine’s Solar Skeleton dial makes the solar plates a visible part of the watch’s design.

kept.name: Teemill
kept.why: Teemill pitches print-on-demand storefronts through concrete choices about how merchandise is made, powered and packaged.

kept.name: Burberry
kept.why: Burberry’s V&A Christmas tree uses biscuit-tin lids and horse brasses to tell a holiday story through familiar British objects.

kept.name: Dior
kept.why: Dior chose animation director Sylvain Chomet to tell its holiday story in the short film Christian Dior’s Night in Color.

kept.name: Tiffany & Co.
kept.why: The Crystal Bridges exhibition places Tiffany & Co.’s orchid brooches alongside an Arkansas diamond to show how nature informs its jewellery.

kept.name: ruko
kept.why: ruko presents its camera drone as a filmmaking tool for beginners, pairing a touchscreen controller with a 48-megapixel camera.
